verdict.rationale: Docs claim real-time deprovisioning tied to role changes/offboarding across connected apps via federated identity (LDAP/AD/OIDC/RADIUS/SCIM/SAML), and device retrieval is automated on offboarding, suggesting a unified offboarding action. However, there's no explicit mention of immediate session termination/kill as part of offboarding, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming instant, comprehensive deprovisioning across all connected apps. Missing for 10: explicit session-kill guarantee, third-party verification of 'one-click offboarding' speed/completeness, and evidence of SCIM deprovisioning across arbitrary connected apps beyond marketing claims.
